blurb: Tuna Wahoo Charters offers family-friendly inshore and offshore fishing trips in Palm Beach and West Palm Beach. Guests fish for species like tuna, wahoo, mahi-mahi, sailfish, kingfish, and swordfish. The charters depart from Riviera Beach Marina and provide all necessary amenities and state-of-the-art fishing gear.

quotes.author: Customer Name
quotes.text: Thank you so much. We had a great time. When we come back, we will definitely give you a call. Thank you again for everything.

Great day with Captain Rich and Paul the Mate. Both Did a nice job explaining about workings of the boat, head and gear before we left the dock. Boat is nicely outfitted for fishing in open water. Paul put out all the lines and we were on fish on no time. We caught a false albacore, barracuda, nice Mahi and a giant 56” Wahoo! A little rain didn’t spoil a great time. Highly recommend
